test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

Some plates are glasses.

Some glasses are bowls.

Some bowls are cups.

Conclusions:

(I) Some cups are glasses.

(II) Some bowls are plates.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5885b3a3c6b197c588112bad5f884cfc09b23b91766e3c4a284d8594cef571c9.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some cups are glasses → Does not follow (As some glasses are bowls and some bowls are cups. So it is possible but not definite.)

(II) Some bowls are plates → Does not follow (As some plates are glasses and some glasses are bowls. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"
